Class BoardSnapshot

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am48.model.snapshot.BoardSnapshot
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class BoardSnapshot extends Object implements Serializable
Serializable, immutable snapshot of the board state. It captures the cards currently showed in the tribe and building rows, the remaining cards in both decks, the offer track and the turn-order card, plus era-related information.

Card collections are stored as lists of card ids rather than full card objects; the ids are resolved back to Card instances when the game is restored from the snapshot.

      public BoardSnapshot(List<String> upperRowCardIds, List<String> lowerRowCardIds, List<String> buildingUpperRowCardIds, List<String> buildingLowerRowCardIds, List<String> tribeDeckRemainingIds, List<String> buildingDeckRemainingIds, OfferTrackSnapshot offerTrack, OfferTurnCardSnapshot offerTurnCard, List<Integer> buildingsPerEra, int currEra, int numPlayers)
      Creates a new board snapshot.
      Parameters:
      upperRowCardIds - ids of the cards in the upper showed tribe row
      lowerRowCardIds - ids of the cards in the lower showed tribe row
      buildingUpperRowCardIds - ids of the cards in the upper showed building row
      buildingLowerRowCardIds - ids of the cards in the lower showed building row
      tribeDeckRemainingIds - ids of the cards still in the tribe deck
      buildingDeckRemainingIds - ids of the cards still in the building deck
      offerTrack - snapshot of the offer track (totem positions)
      offerTurnCard - snapshot of the turn-order card (totem order)
      buildingsPerEra - number of buildings to draw for each era
      currEra - the index of the current era
      numPlayers - the number of players in the game
